layers.process: A park entry fee for foreign adults, reported as US$200 (about A$284 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040) since August 2024, half for children under 12. Sources disagree on cash at the airport versus an online portal.
A Transit Control Card, reported as US$20 (about A$28), bought at Quito or Guayaquil airport before the flight to the islands.

layers.authority: Dirección del Parque Nacional Galápagos (under Ordenanza Provincial 001-CGREG-30-06-2025)
layers.process: Conservation entry fee for the Galápagos protected areas, collected by the National Park Directorate: foreign tourists over 12 pay US$200 (about A$284 at RBA, 30 October 2026: A$1 = US$0.7040), under 12 pay US$100 (about A$142). Children under 2 are exempt.

layers.authority: Consejo de Gobierno del Régimen Especial de Galápagos (CGREG)
layers.process: The Transit Control Card (TCT) is issued by the Galápagos Governing Council; the council's site links to an online TCT issuing portal (siig-cgreg.gobiernogalapagos.gob.ec). Get it before the flight to the islands. The price was not shown on the council pages read.

sources.title: Consejo de Gobierno del Régimen Especial de Galápagos (home, TCT Online link)

zone-requirements.note: Confirm the fee and payment method on the Galápagos Governing Council or National Park Directorate site. Official fee table read 5 November 2026 confirms US$200 for foreign tourists over 12; the TCT price still rests on the earlier signal.
